summary.text: Dick Lowe is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 56 since November 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A rancher, he was unopposed in the Republican primary, which was canceled.

paragraphs.text: Dick Lowe graduated from Ninnekah High School and earned a degree in animal science from Oklahoma State University.
His career experience includes working as a cattle rancher and agriculture education instructor.
Lowe assumed office on November 18, 2020, succeeding David Perryman, and for 2025-2026 was assigned to the Education Oversight Committee.
In 2023-2024 he also served on the Appropriations and Budget Committee.
